title: Renames the `rendering_options` attribute for invoices to `rendering`
summary: Renames the rendering_options attribute for invoices to rendering.

migrationNotes.text: Renaming the rendering_options attribute for invoices to rendering simplifies the attribute’s name. You need to update your code to access and modify these invoice rendering settings under the new rendering structure.
